display_title: You Can Blame It All on Me
description:
Seong-Yoon, a true otaku who only enjoys Dating Sims, falls for the beautiful Dalsa who looks just like his favorite and ends up entering a motel while drunk...

Why... does my behind hurt like it's been stabbed in the back?

*"You were the one who got stabbed. I'm also a man who's into it...^^"*

That Dalsa is actually a man...? This cross-dressing man is the most popular kid in our department, Woo Soo-Hee...?! A sweet and cute love story between the scheming master Woo Soo-Hee, who will cross-dress to win over Sung-Yoon, and the nerdy, otaku Sung-Yoon, 

"You can blame it all on me♡" 

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
